definitions.gloss: to copy down; to transcribe; to write out
definitions.explanation: To reproduce text by writing it out by hand, copying from one source to another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}す。
examples.english: To copy down what's on the blackboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}した。
examples.english: I copied the sentences from the textbook into my notebook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}して⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: I carefully transcribed the old letters and preserved them as a record.

notes:
A compound godan verb (⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ + ⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧) meaning to copy text by writing it out. Implies manual handwriting rather than mechanical or digital copying.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy from the blackboard
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy into a notebook
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to carefully transcribe
- ⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy the original text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧: to copy — the base verb; broader meaning including photographing and copying by any means
- {書|か}き{取|と}る: to write down, to take dictation — writing from spoken words rather than from a written source
- {転記|てんき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transcribe, to transfer (data) — more formal; used for transferring information between records or documents
- ⟦{模写|もしゃ}→模写：19473_mosha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to copy, to reproduce — used for copying artwork or visual materials, not just text
